parsed.answer: Evidence from cryoEM reconstructions of the bacterial 30S initiation complex shows that IF3, together with initiator tRNA, undergoes large conformational changes that facilitate accommodation of fMet-tRNA(fMet) into the P site for start codon recognition, indicating IF3 is directly involved in this process. The claim is therefore supported by source 16927286. Source 18987782 concerns Myc-driven translation initiation and ribosomal protein haploinsufficiency and provides no information on start codon recognition or IF3.
